skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 2 combo hits, dealing 50% ATK DMG each.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes enemies in a cross-shaped area with 3 combo hits, dealing 40% ATK DMG each; the final hit drains 100% of the DMG dealt to heal herself.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes enemies in a cross-shaped area with 3 combo hits, dealing 40% ATK DMG each; the final hit drains 100% of the DMG dealt to heal herself, and the first and second hits each have a 100% chance to drain 100% of the DMG dealt to heal as well.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Grants 33% [Non-Crit DMG Free] (effective for all DMG types, cannot co-exist with [Agility]). After an ally attacks (starting from round 2), [Awaken] Mosquito Girl launches a [Follow-up] on the enemy with the lowest HP ratio (80% of Basic Attack DMG with special effects, 4 times per round).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Free] 33% > 38%. [Follow-up] 80% > 90% Basic Attack, 4 > 5 times per round.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Free] 38% > 45%. [Follow-up] 90% > 100% Basic Attack. Trigger window: from round 2 > from round 1.
